initialSiteSettings.missionAf: Effektiivi-le teknoolojii warsiisak, doorsiisak, ellecabo horsiisak kee taamah gaceenamah cabiimu saynis kee teknoolojii horoyaay tabaatabsak rakaakay caddol xiqewaay.

initialSiteSettings.missionEn: To ensure the region's growth by developing and transferring science and technology that enables the search, selection, adaptation, creation, and use of effective technologies.
initialSiteSettings.visionAf: Xiinisso kee cuglisak duudusiime ineewaa teknoolojii daddossiiy askaasita, amaanat-le sistem horoysiiy dijitaal xaqbo massowak rakaakay ummattah cateynay xiqewaay.

initialSiteSettings.historyAf: Qafar Agatih Rakaakayih Doolatak Saynis, Innoveshin kee Teknolojik Biiro sanatah 2005 E.C. addat qimbiseeni. Rakaakayal dijital tabaatabsih daddos kee sayber amni dacayrih taama miraacisak geytima.
initialSiteSettings.historyAm: የአፋር ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት ሳይንስ፣ ኢኖቬሽን እና ቴክኖሎጂ ቢሮ በክልሉ የሳይንስና ቴክኖሎጂ አቅምን ለማሳደግ፣ የመንግስት አሰራርን ለማዘመንና አስተማማኝ የመረጃ ደህንነትን ለማስፈን ተቋቁሞ ሰፊ ስራዎችን በማከናወን ላይ ይገኛል።
initialSiteSettings.historyEn: The Bureau was established with the aim of protecting our country's information and information infrastructures from attacks and safeguarding national interests. Our goal is to build the capacity to ensure the security of the country's information and information infrastructure, thereby protecting national interests and realizing a national capacity that can ensure information superiority.
initialSiteSettings.bureauHeadMsgAf: Qafar Rakaakayak Saynis Teknoloji Kee Innoveshin Komishinik Komishiner Injineer Saqid Macammad Ta Tadeera Abtol Asisak Rakaakay Luddal Taamitoonuh Ekraariseenih Yanin Cato Lem Qaddoysak, Ta Inistituyut Rakaakayitte Fanah Cugaysoosa Baahoonuh Abak Geytiman Macal Bisoh Axcelem Kassiise.
initialSiteSettings.bureauHeadMsgAm: የዘንድሮው ብሄራዊ የስፔስና ዓለም አቀፍ የጂአይኤስ ቀን በአል ማጠቃለያ ዝግጅት በአፋር ብሄራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት ተካሂዷል። የአፋር ክልል የሳይንስ፣ ቴክኖሎጂ እና ኢኖቬሽን ኮሚሽን ኮምሽነር ኢንጂነር ሰኢድ ሙሃመድ የፕሮግራም መካሄድ ክልሉ በዘርፉ ለመስራት የያዘውን እቅድ እንደሚያግዝ አንስተው ኢንስቲትዩቱ ፕሮጀክቶችን ወደ ክልሎች ለማውረድ የጀመረውን ጥረት አጠናክሮ እንዲቀጥል ጠይቀዋል።
initialSiteSettings.bureauHeadMsgEn: This year's National Space and International GIS Day took place at the Afar National Regional Government. Eng. Saeed Mohammed, Commissioner of the Afar Region Science, Technology and Innovation Commission, said that carrying out the program will support the region's plan to develop the sector and asked the institute to keep working on bringing projects to the region.

initialDirectorates.descriptionEn: This directorate mainly leads the process of moving technologies from universities, research institutes, companies, and foreign partners to industries, government bodies, and startups. initialSectors.descriptionEn: Cataloging indigenous nomadic knowledge, ecological wisdom, and traditional innovations through digital archives.

initialSectors.descriptionAf: Qusba ellecaboh migaaqi dacayri kee patent mirhise.

initialSectors.descriptionEn: Providing mechanical diagnosis, PCB-level repairs, and diagnostic maintenance for government electromechanical installations.

initialSectors.nameAm: አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ አላምዶ፤ ተጠቅሞ የተቋማት የቴክኖሎጂ ሽግግርን ማፋጠን እና አሰራርን ማዘመን

initialNews.titleAf: Asanat Agat Space Kee Baadak GIS Ayroh Massakaxxa Qafar Agatih Rakaakayih Doolat Gexisse
initialNews.titleAm: የዘንድሮው ብሄራዊ የስፔስና ዓለም አቀፍ የጂአይኤስ ቀን ማጠቃለያ በአፋር ክልል ተካሄደ
initialNews.titleEn: National Space and International GIS Day Culmination Celebrated in Semera
initialNews.excerptAf: Asanat Agat Space Kee Baadak GIS Ayroh Massakaxxa Qafar Agatih Rakaakayih Doolat Gexisse.
initialNews.excerptAm: የዘንድሮው ብሄራዊ የስፔስና ዓለም አቀፍ የጂአይኤስ ቀን በአል ማጠቃለያ ዝግጅት በአፋር ብሄራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት ተካሂዷል።
initialNews.excerptEn: This year's National Space and International GIS Day celebration successfully concluded in Semera, Afar Regional State.
initialNews.contentAf: Asanat Agat Space Kee Baadak GIS Ayroh Massakaxxa Qafar Agatih Rakaakayih Doolat Gexisse. Qafar Rakaakayak Saynis Teknoloji Kee Innoveshin Komishinik Komishiner Injineer Saqid Macammad Ta Tadeera Abtol Asisak Rakaakay Luddal Taamitoonuh Ekraariseenih Yanin Cato Lem Qaddoysak, Ta Inistituyut Rakaakayitte Fanah Cugaysoosa Baahoonuh Abak Geytiman Macal Bisoh Axcelem Kassiise.
initialNews.contentAm: የዘንድሮው ብሄራዊ የስፔስና ዓለም አቀፍ የጂአይኤስ ቀን በአል ማጠቃለያ ዝግጅት በአፋር ብሄራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት ተካሂዷል። የአፋር ክልል የሳይንስ፣ ቴክኖሎጂ እና ኢኖቬሽን ኮሚሽን ኮምሽነር ኢንጂነር ሰኢድ ሙሃመድ የፕሮግራም መካሄድ ክልሉ በዘርፉ ለመስራት የያዘውን እቅድ እንደሚያግዝ አንስተው ኢንስቲትዩቱ ፕሮጀክቶችን ወደ ክልሎች ለማውረድ የጀመረውን ጥረት አጠናክሮ እንዲቀጥል ጠይቀዋል።
initialNews.contentEn: This year's National Space and International GIS Day took place at the Afar National Regional Government. Eng. Saeed Mohammed, Commissioner of the Afar Region Science, Technology and Innovation Commission, said that carrying out the program will support the region's plan to develop the sector and asked the institute to keep working on bringing projects to the region.

initialNews.titleAm: የሰመራ ዳታ ማዕከል እና የክልላዊ ፋይበር ኔትወርክ ማስፋፊያ ተጠናቀቀ
initialNews.titleEn: Semera Regional Datacenter and High-Speed Fiber Network Completed
initialNews.excerptAf: Qafar Rakaakayih Doolat Semeral Qasri Datacentre xissiyyah taama gaba kalte.
initialNews.excerptAm: የአፋር ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት የመንግስት ተቋማትን በዘመናዊ ፋይበር ኔትወርክ የሚያስተሳስር ፕሮጀክት ይፋ አደረገ።
initialNews.excerptEn: The Afar Bureau of Science, Innovation and Technology has completed the regional tier-ready datacenter and government intranet connecting regional secretariats in Semera.
initialNews.contentAf: Semeral Qasri Datacentre xissiyyah taama gaba kalte. Ta tadeera rakaakayak doolat xisoosah dijital xaqbo dadlisuh kaxxa cato le.
initialNews.contentAm: የአፋር ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት ሳይንስ፣ ኢኖቬሽን እና ቴክኖሎጂ ቢሮ በሰመራ ከተማ የተገነባውን ዘመናዊ የመረጃ ማዕከል እና የፋይበር ኔትወርክ ማስፋፊያ አጠናቆ ለአገልግሎት አብቅቷል። ይህም የመንግስት አገልግሎቶችን በዲጂታል ቴክኖሎጂ ለማቅረብ ከፍተኛ አስተዋጽኦ ያበረክታል።
initialNews.contentEn: The modern datacenter infrastructure built in Semera is designed to provide secure, redundant hosting for regional public services, educational portals, and cybersecurity monitoring systems.

initialNews.titleAf: Qafar Rakaakay Qusba Ellecabo kee Startup Cato Yaceenih
initialNews.titleAm: ለአፋር ወጣት የፈጠራ ባለቤቶች እና ጀማሪ ቴክኖሎጂዎች የድጋፍ መርሃ ግብር ይፋ ሆነ
initialNews.titleEn: Youth Innovation Challenge & Startup Incubation Grant Announced
initialNews.excerptAf: Ellecabo kee Startup tabaatabsih daddos komishin qokol yacee.
initialNews.excerptAm: በአፋር ክልል የሚገኙ ወጣት የቴክኖሎጂ ፈጣሪዎችን ለማበረታታት የገንዘብ እና የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ ፕሮግራም ተጀመረ።
initialNews.excerptEn: The Directorate of Innovation Ecosystem Support has launched a grant competition for youth developing solutions in pastoral water tracking, renewable solar monitoring, and education apps.
initialNews.contentAf: Qafar Rakaakayal qusba teknoloji ellecaboh daddos tadeera qimbiseeni. Ta tadeeral xalootleelle qusba cato yaceenih.
initialNews.contentAm: በአፋር ክልል የሳይንስና ቴክኖሎጂ ቢሮ የኢኖቬሽን እና ስታርትፕ ድጋፍ ዳይሬክቶሬት በክልሉ የሚገኙ ወጣት ፈጣሪዎችን እና ጀማሪ ኢንተርፕራይዞችን የሚያበረታታ የፈጠራ ውድድርና የስልጠና መድረክ አዘጋጅቷል።
initialNews.contentEn: Selected startup founders will receive incubation space at the Semera Tech Hub, cloud server credits, and mentorship from national cybersecurity and software engineering experts.

initialEvents.titleAm: የአፋር ክልላዊ የሳይበር ደህንነት የግንዛቤ ማስጨበጫ ፎረም

initialEvents.descriptionAf: Jaamiqat barteeni kee qusba ellecabo le mara sittat bahak 48 saaqatih hackathon gexisen.
initialEvents.descriptionAm: ከሰመራ ዩኒቨርሲቲ እና ከመላው ክልሉ የተውጣጡ ወጣት ፕሮግራመሮች እና የፈጠራ ሰዎች የሚሳተፉበት የ48 ሰዓት የሶፍትዌር ውድድር።
initialEvents.descriptionEn: A 48-hour competitive software challenge for software developers, data scientists, and engineers building solutions for pastoralist logistics, localized health dispatch, and drought alert forecasting.

initialEvents.descriptionAf: Doolatak hospitaalitte kee xisoosah electromechanical silaacitte dambiyoo baritto.
initialEvents.descriptionAm: በክልሉ ለሚገኙ የጤና ተቋማት እና የመንግስት መስሪያ ቤቶች የህክምና እና የቢሮ መሳሪያዎች ጥገና ስልጠና።
initialEvents.descriptionEn: Hands-on technical workshop for regional biomedical and mechanical technicians on diagnostic calibration and circuit board refurbishments.

initialFaqs.questionEn: What core services does the Afar Science, Innovation and Technology Bureau deliver?
initialFaqs.answerAf: Biiro sayber amni dacayri, software kee databeys daddosa, ICT infrastructure xizaayin, qusba ellecabo kee startup cato, electromechanical silaacitte dambiyoo kee teknooloji patent mirhise yaceeh.
initialFaqs.answerAm: ቢሮው የሳይበር ደህንነት ጥበቃ፣ የመንግስት ሶፍትዌርና ዳታቤዝ ልማት፣ የዳታ ማዕከል እና ኔትወርክ መሰረተ ልማት፣ የስታርትፕ ፈጠራ ድጋፍ፣ የኤሌክትሮ መካኒክ ጥገና እና የፓተንት መብት ማረጋገጫን ጨምሮ 12 ቁልፍ አገልግሎቶችን ይሰጣል።
initialFaqs.answerEn: The Bureau provides 12 specialized services including cybersecurity audits & 24/7 incident defense, custom software & database development, state ICT datacenter operations, youth startup ecosystem grants, electromechanical refurbishments, and technology patent validation.

initialFaqs.questionAf: Qusba ellecabo le num startup qokol kah geytah inna mannaa?
initialFaqs.questionAm: አዳዲስ የፈጠራ ስራ ያላቸው ወጣቶችና ጀማሪዎች እንዴት ድጋፍ ማግኘት ይችላሉ?
initialFaqs.questionEn: How can young entrepreneurs and tech startups apply for innovation support?
initialFaqs.answerAf: Ellecabo kee Startup Xayrektoreet fanah Semeral tan buxal makteb gacaay hinnay portalal tan form dambisaay rub.
initialFaqs.answerAm: በሰመራ በሚገኘው የኢኖቬሽንና ስታርትፕ ድጋፍ ዳይሬክቶሬት ቢሮ በአካል በመገኘት ወይም በድረ-ገጻችን የኦንላይን ማመልከቻ በመሙላት የቴክኒክ ስልጠና፣ የመስሪያ ቦታ እና የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ማግኘት ይችላሉ።
initialFaqs.answerEn: You can submit your project proposal directly through our online contact form or visit the Directorate of Innovation & Technology Start-up Ecosystem Support at our Semera headquarters to access incubation mentorship, workspace, and grant funding.

initialFaqs.questionAf: Doolat xisoosah sayber amni dacayrih qokol kah geytah inna?
initialFaqs.questionAm: የመንግስት ተቋማት የሳይበር ደህንነት እና የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ እንዴት ማግኘት ይችላሉ?
initialFaqs.questionEn: How do public regional agencies request cybersecurity audits or infrastructure connectivity?
initialFaqs.answerAf: Sayber Amni Xayrektoreet fanah rasmi warqi rubaay hinnay emergency hotline +251 33 666 0192 gacsisa.
initialFaqs.answerAm: የመንግስት ተቋማት ይፋዊ የድጋፍ ደብዳቤ ለቢሮው በማስገባት ወይም በስልክ ቁጥር +251 33 666 0192 በመደወል አፋጣኝ የሳይበር ደህንነት ፍተሻ፣ የኔትወርክ ዝርጋታ እና የሲስተም ልማት ድጋፍ ማግኘት ይችላሉ።
initialFaqs.answerEn: Regional bureaus and institutions can submit formal technical requests or reach our 24/7 emergency cyber response desk at +251 33 666 0192 for urgent vulnerability remediation, network cabling, or software integration.

initialFaqs.questionAm: የቢሮው ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት የት ይገኛል?
initialFaqs.questionEn: Where is the Bureau headquarters located and what are the working hours?
initialFaqs.answerAf: Qafar Agatih Rakaakay, Semera City Doolat Compound addal geytima. Taama saaqat Sanbat-Arbaqa 2:30k Fanah 11:30 Kinnim.
initialFaqs.answerAm: ዋና መስሪያ ቤታችን በአፋር ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት ሰመራ ከተማ፣ በክልሉ አስተዳደር ግቢ ውስጥ ይገኛል። የስራ ሰዓት ከሰኞ እስከ አርብ ከጠዋቱ 2:30 እስከ ቀኑ 11:30 ነው።
initialFaqs.answerEn: Our main bureau headquarters is situated inside the Regional Administration Complex in Semera, Afar, Ethiopia. Working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM.
